Independent reviewer opened all three current sheets at native resolution, originals and native detail crops; no material findings. Qualitative scale and grooming states remain provisional.
Original two-paw fist support and separate nose-elbow topology inspected and reused.

New upper staging has all dogs inside and humans outside closed glass, feet grounded; lower close-up has connected relaxed torso, supported chest/hips and clear single paw-hand contact. Finish corrections: smooth coats, tiny nub, tidy Buddy nape, tapered tail.

observations.finding: The accepted dinner invitation nobody issued, Buddy searching beneath the cabinet he hits, synchronized six-inch moves at the glass, and the thumb-opening strategy give concrete physical jokes. Neet treats exclusion as a personal scandal; Buddy pursues food pragmatically. Sagar enjoys theatrical naming and instruction while Heather punctures his claims and records the dogs dismantling him. These remain distinct voices.

Buddy tries visible good manners, supports a second complaint after cheese rewards the first, probes the fist opening, tries the elbow, learns by watching the reward, and over-applies the bump. His final unrewarded paw touch turns his own learning into affection.

Small balcony leads to exclusion; cheese inadvertently reinforces complaint; surviving naan motivates training; clearer demonstration yields learning. Short separate paragraphs for the open eye, competing checks, and extra bump give the jokes room. Final empty-hand contact is earned and ends after the human speech with action.

Balcony image follows the good-manners obstruction before the rolling protest or cheese. Training image follows the double-paw/elbow mistake and precedes the successful single bump; grounded Buddy reads as a moment within repeated jumps. Final picture follows empty-hand contact, with no naan visible, and leaves sleeping Neet outside its crop. Wide separation, close physical confusion, and low quiet contact offer distinct contributions without preempting reveals.
All pictures load cleanly; text remains readable, dialogue attribution uninterrupted, and the last picture lets the emotional action linger before clearly separated editorial notes.

Blue balcony shirt becomes white indoors without prose explanation. Independently noticeable on comparison, but the scene break and later indoor action keep actor, sequence and cause/effect unambiguous; no clothing-dependent joke or event relies on it. This is a minor visual continuity inconsistency, not a material narrative failure.
